title: Lake Placid gateway
narration: Lake Placid is a village in the Adirondack Mountains and a gateway to the High Peaks region. It famously hosted the Winter Olympics twice, and today its lakeshore and Main Street draw travelers heading into the mountains.

title: Keene Valley
narration: Keene Valley sits among dramatic Adirondack mountain scenery and is a beloved basecamp for hikers, with trailheads fanning out toward the highest peaks in New York State.

title: Cascade Lakes
narration: The Cascade Lakes corridor is a scenic approach through the High Peaks landscape, where the road threads between steep slopes and water, a favorite stop for photos and quick hikes.

title: High Peaks Wilderness
narration: The High Peaks Wilderness is part of New York's Adirondack Park and contains the tallest summits in the state, including Mount Marcy, a vast protected expanse of forest, rock, and alpine summits.
